checkpoint_selection.policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1

interpretation.observed: E2M3 exceeds E4M3 throughout epochs51-100, E2M1 exceeds E4M3 throughout76-100; one correlated training trajectory, not independent repeated runs.
interpretation.training_objectives_differ: E4M3 hard CE; E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3; E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3. Student train loss magnitudes are not directly comparable with teacher hard CE.
interpretation.precision_specific_BN: Frozen learned BN parameters and running statistics differ by mode; equal master weights do not imply identical complete network functions.
interpretation.plausible_not_proven_explanation: Joint optimization, soft-target regularization, quantization and precision-specific BN may change generalization. Observed reversal of train/test ranking is compatible with this, not a causal diagnosis.
interpretation.paper_context: Uploaded Any-Precision paper PDFpage7 Knowledge Distillation section explicitly presents soft-target regularization of lower-bit training as a hypothesis; original paper results are not this MX/A32/train-only experiment.
interpretation.suggested_paired_diagnostics: Store ordered per-example labels and predictions at both shared checkpoints; report A-only/B-only correct, both correct, both wrong, and prediction disagreements against corresponding direct target route.
interpretation.weight_distortion_note: Direct E4M3/E2M3 share three mantissa bits but use different local exponent ranges and scale rules. E4M3 finite cap448 makes representable sets not strictly nested after blockscale choice; more bits does not imply monotonic tensor error or classifier accuracy. Diagnostics from runtime exportCSVs, no causal claim.

evidence_limits: Feedback contains reports and layer CSVs, not checkpoint/export tensors, SVHN arrays, sample-order arrays, or minibatch logs.
Source and distributed package hashes, all600 metric CSV/history rows, selection arithmetic, and timing arithmetic independently checked.
BN/gradient/Adam/sample-coverage/exact export checks are runtime assertions reported by hash-verified code; underlying tensors not independently reloaded.
Export check covers decoded weights on training device, not a repeated complete exported-model test pass.
One-seed rank inversion does not establish a general causal benefit of lower precision.
Marginal correct counts lack paired disagreement information; no paired significance statement is justified.
Best checkpoint selected using official test; not an independent held-out estimate.
